bug_semantics: GET /api/system/logs, GET /api/system/logs/stream, and GET /ws/system/logs are registered on JWT-authenticated groups but never require an admin role/scope. GetSystemLogs() and QueryLogFileTail() return app.log contents to any valid user; SSE/WS handlers only jwtUtil.ParseToken(token). Any authenticated non-admin can read paths, stack traces, and internal URLs (CWE-862).
